plugins.name: nightshift
plugins.description: Codex inside Claude Code: it picks up the chat when your Claude limit runs out, talks with you through Codex's live voice, makes images Claude can ask for, and browses in Claude's browser pane

plugins.name: third-eye
plugins.description: A footnote under Claude's reply with one idea you wouldn't have suggested yourself

plugins.name: grudge
plugins.description: Every look you reject becomes a rule for that project, with your screenshot, so Claude never brings it back

plugins.name: bouncer
plugins.description: Paste a link with a short question and Claude's answer opens with a verdict for your projects: use it, later or skip, the effort, the cost and one line why

plugins.name: clock
plugins.description: Every prompt carries your local date, weekday and the week ranges, and a reply whose dates miss the period you asked about gets flagged

plugins.name: updates
plugins.description: A weekly check of your Claude and Codex plugins, global npm packages and adapted skills for newer versions, with a one-line summary of each

plugins.name: tree-of-mods
plugins.description: /mods opens a panel beside the chat with the mods you made and the plugins you installed: on or off, tests, updates you can apply, and your repo's GitHub numbers
